errors.text: The proposed internal Zr/Ti powder getter differs from the titanium-sponge oxygen getter used during vacuum sintering; adding 2–5 wt% Zr and 2 wt% Ti also destroys the nominally equiatomic alloy composition.
The proposed high-purity Ar atmosphere and 10–20 minute dwell conflict with vacuum sintering below 3×10^-6 torr at 1400 °C for 18 hours, following hydrogen de-binding.
The hypothesis incorrectly targets oxygen below 0.15 wt%, whereas the target process retains approximately 1.0 wt% oxygen for interstitial strengthening while controlling phase stability.
The predicted 0.5–2 µm grain size is unsupported and strongly disagrees with the measured post-quench grain size of 33 ± 19 µm.
Quenching from 1350–1400 °C is proposed instead of water quenching from the 1500 °C homogenization temperature.
